question:
At an event, the total cost of $4$ adult tickets and $3$ child tickets is $₹510$, while the total cost of $2$ adult tickets and $5$ child tickets is $₹430$. Let the prices of one adult ticket and one child ticket be $₹x$ and $₹y$, respectively.

(a) Form the system of equations and express it in matrix form.

(b) Solve the system using the inverse-matrix method.

(c) Verify the obtained ticket prices using the given costs.
explanation:
(a)
The required equations are
$$4x+3y=510$$
$$2x+5y=430$$
In matrix form,
$$\begin{bmatrix}4 & 3\\2 & 5\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}x\\y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}510\\430\end{bmatrix}$$

(b)
Let
$$A=\begin{bmatrix}4 & 3\\2 & 5\end{bmatrix}$$
Then,
$$|A|=4(5)-3(2)=14\neq0$$
Therefore,
$$A^{-1}=\frac{1}{14}\begin{bmatrix}5 & -3\\-2 & 4\end{bmatrix}$$
Now,
$$\begin{bmatrix}x\\y\end{bmatrix}=A^{-1}\begin{bmatrix}510\\430\end{bmatrix}$$
$$=\frac{1}{14}\begin{bmatrix}5 & -3\\-2 & 4\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}510\\430\end{bmatrix}$$
$$=\frac{1}{14}\begin{bmatrix}2550-1290\\-1020+1720\end{bmatrix}=\frac{1}{14}\begin{bmatrix}1260\\700\end{bmatrix}$$
Thus,
$$x=90,\quad y=50$$
The adult ticket costs $₹90$ and the child ticket costs $₹50$.

(c)
$$4(90)+3(50)=360+150=510$$
$$2(90)+5(50)=180+250=430$$
Hence, both given costs are verified.

options.A:
(a) $4x+3y=510,\ 2x+5y=430$
(b) Adult ticket $₹80$, child ticket $₹60$
(c) Both totals are verified
